sentences.text:
This Criminal Revision, under Sections 397 and 401 of Cr.P.C., has been filed against the order dated 22.04.2024 passed by XVII Additional Sessions Judge, Gwalior in ST No.30/2024 by which charges have been framed for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 294 and 506 Part II of IPC and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act against applicants No.1 to 3 and an additional charge under Section 377 of IPC has also been framed against applicant No.4.
2.

It is submitted by counsel for the applicants that applicants No.1 to 3 have filed M.Cr.C.
No.6925/2024 for quashment of charge-sheet.

Since criminal revision has been filed against the charges which have been framed during the pendency of M.Cr.C. No.6925/2024, therefore,
applicants would not like to press this Criminal Revision and may be permitted to withdraw the same with liberty to press M.Cr.C. No.6925/2024.
With aforesaid liberty, this revision is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE (and)
